tasks.instruction: Dismiss any cookie or consent banner. In the main paste editor, type the text 'Hello from CUA agent test 2026 — dpaste smoke check'. Set the expiry/lifetime dropdown to '1 day' (or the shortest available option), then click the 'dpaste it' / Submit button. On the resulting page, confirm the saved snippet's short URL is displayed in the address bar and copy it.

Type a 3-line Python snippet (def hello():\n    print('cua test')\nhello()) into the editor, select 'Python' from the syntax dropdown, set expiry to '1 week', then click 'dpaste it'. Verify the result page renders the highlighted code and shows its permanent share URL.

Dismiss any banner. Click into the editor area, type 'CUA agent hastebin test — save and share 2026', then press the Save key/icon (the duplicate-document Save button in the top toolbar, or Ctrl+S). Confirm the URL changes to a hash-suffixed share link and that the document switches to read-only saved view.

Type a short multi-line note ('Line 1: CUA test\nLine 2: timestamp 2026-06-13\nLine 3: done') into the editor, click Save, then confirm a new short URL appears and the saved key is visible in the address bar.

Dismiss cookie banner if present. Type 'Ghostbin CUA test 2026 — anonymous paste' into the paste body field, set expiration to '1 hour', leave it unencrypted/public, then click the Paste/Create button. Confirm the result page displays the new paste's URL.

Enter a title 'cua-smoke' in the title field, type body text 'verifying ghostbin publish flow', choose expiry '1 day', click Create, and verify the published paste page shows the title and a share URL.

Dismiss any consent/ad banner. Click into the large text box, type 'controlc.com CUA agent publish test 2026', leave the paste public, then click the 'Create New Paste' button at the bottom. Confirm the resulting page shows the saved paste with its numeric share URL.
Type 'expiry test note for cua' into the paste box, set the 'Paste Expiration' dropdown to '10 Minutes', click Create New Paste, and verify the new paste URL is displayed on the result page.

Dismiss cookie banner. In the paste content area type 'paste.ee guest CUA test 2026', set 'Paste Expiration' to '15 minutes' and visibility to Public, then click the Submit/Paste button. Confirm the published paste page loads at a /p/ URL and the content is shown.
Type 'cua description test' in the Description field, paste body 'verifying paste.ee publish', set expiry '1 hour', click Submit, and verify the result page shows the description and the share URL.

Dismiss any banner. Type 'zerobin client-encrypted CUA test 2026' into the paste area, choose expiry '1 day', then click the 'Send' button. Wait for client-side encryption to finish and confirm the page displays the generated share URL containing the decryption key in the fragment (#).
Type 'burn after reading test' into the editor, set the expiration dropdown to 'Burn after reading', click Send, and verify a share URL is produced on the resulting page.

Dismiss any notice. In the editor type 'PrivateBin demo CUA test 2026 — encrypted send', set Expiration to '5 minutes', leave format Plain Text, then click 'Send'. Confirm the success view appears with a full share URL (including the key after #) and a 'copy URL' control.

Type '# CUA heading\nbody text' into the editor, change the Format dropdown to 'Markdown', enable 'Burn after reading', set expiry '1 hour', click Send, and verify the encrypted paste URL is displayed.

On the paste.rs landing page, click into the textarea, type 'paste.rs CUA web test 2026', then submit the form (press the submit control or Ctrl+Enter). Confirm the browser navigates to the returned short URL and the raw text is shown.

Dismiss any banner. In the file-upload section click 'Choose Files' / the file picker and select a small local text file (e.g. /tmp/cua_test.txt; create it if the picker allows, otherwise pick any small file), then click 'Upload'. Wait for the upload to finish and confirm a https://files.catbox.moe/ direct link is displayed in the result box; copy it.

Switch to the 'Upload via URL' tab, paste a public image URL (https://i.imgur.com/ ... or any direct image) into the URL field, click Upload, and verify the result box shows a new files.catbox.moe link to the rehosted file.

Dismiss cookie banner. Click the upload drop-zone to open the file picker and select a small local file, then wait for the upload progress bar to complete. Confirm the page displays a generated https://file.io/ download link and a 'Copy' button; copy the link.
Upload any small local file via the drop-zone, wait for the one-time download URL to appear, then click the Copy-link button and confirm a 'Copied' / success toast is shown.

On the 0x0.st landing page use the HTML upload form: click the file input, choose a small local file, then click the form's submit/Upload button. Confirm the browser returns a plain-text https://0x0.st/ short URL pointing to the uploaded file.

Dismiss cookie/consent banner. Click 'Upload File' / the drop-zone, select a small local file, and wait for the upload to complete. Confirm a gofile.io/d/ download page link is generated and shown with a Copy button; copy the link.
Upload a small local file, wait for completion, then click the generated download-page link and verify the share page opens showing the uploaded file name and a Download button.

Dismiss any ad/cookie banner. Click the upload area to open the file picker, select a small local file, click Upload, and wait for processing. Confirm a https://tmpfiles.org/ link to the uploaded file is displayed; copy it.

Dismiss cookie/consent banner. Click 'Choose Images' / the upload button, select a small local image file, leave 'Don't autoresize' / default options, then click Upload. Wait for the result page and confirm the 'Direct link' field with a https://i.postimg.cc/ URL is shown; copy it.

Open the expiration dropdown and choose '1 day', then upload a small local image and verify the result page shows the multiple share-link fields (Direct link, Hotlink, Markdown) for the uploaded image.

Open a public/demo contact form template that allows direct submission (or the Jotform 'Contact Us' demo). Dismiss cookie banner. Fill Name 'CUA Test', Email 'cua-test@example.com', and a Message 'Automated CUA submission 2026', then click Submit. Confirm the 'Your submission has been received' thank-you page is shown.

Open the public contact-form template preview. Dismiss any cookie banner. Step through the form fields (type Name 'CUA Test', Email 'cua-test@example.com', and answer the message question 'CUA agent submission 2026'), pressing OK/Enter between steps, then click Submit on the final step. Confirm the 'Thanks!' completion screen is displayed.

Dismiss cookie/consent banner. In the homepage poll builder type the question 'Best day for CUA standup?', fill three options 'Mon', 'Wed', 'Fri', then click 'Create Poll'. Confirm the result page shows the live poll with a shareable poll URL; copy it.

Create a poll with question 'Tabs or spaces?' and options 'Tabs','Spaces', click Create Poll, then on the live page cast a vote for 'Spaces' and confirm the results bar chart updates and the share link is shown.

On the blank write.as editor, type a title line 'CUA Test Post 2026' then body 'Published anonymously by the CUA agent.', and click the 'Publish' button. Confirm the post is published at a write.as/ URL shown in the address bar and a 'View Post / Share' link is available.

Dismiss cookie/consent banner. Click into the rich editor, type 'JustPaste.it CUA publish test 2026 — heading and body text.', then click the 'Publish' button. Confirm the page redirects to the published justpaste.it/ short URL and shows the rendered note plus a share link.

In the txt.fyi editor type 'txt.fyi CUA minimal publish test 2026', then click the 'Publish' button at the bottom. Confirm the post is published to a unique txt.fyi/ URL displayed on the resulting page.

Dismiss cookie banner. Search for a public-domain title (e.g. 'Pride and Prejudice'), open its book page, click the 'Download' button, choose the EPUB format, and confirm a file download begins (download started indicator / browser download bar shows the .epub).

Dismiss cookie banner. Open a public-domain book from the catalog, on its detail page click the EPUB 'Download' button (free), and confirm the .epub download starts (browser download indicator appears).

Dismiss cookie banner. Search the catalog for 'Aesop's Fables' (or any short title), open the audiobook page, and from the chapter listing click an MP3 download link for one chapter. Confirm the .mp3 file download begins.

Dismiss banner. Search for a public-domain title (e.g. 'Alice in Wonderland'), open an edition that is 'Read' / public domain, click the download/format option (e.g. 'PDF' or 'Send to' → epub from the read panel), and confirm a downloadable file link is produced or a download starts.

Open a complete public-domain work's main page (e.g. search 'The Time Machine'), use the sidebar 'Download as EPUB' / 'Download as PDF' export tool, wait for the rendering job to finish, and confirm the generated EPUB/PDF file downloads.
Dismiss cookie banner. Search for 'mountains', open a photo result, click the green 'Free Download' button, choose the default/Original size if prompted, and confirm the .jpg image download starts.
Search 'coffee', open a photo, open the Download dropdown, select the 'Medium' size option, click Download, and confirm the image file download begins at the chosen resolution.

Dismiss cookie/consent banner. Search 'sunset', open an image result, click the 'Download' button, pick a resolution from the size list, then click the final Download. If a captcha-free direct download is available confirm the file download starts; otherwise confirm the download dialog with the chosen size is shown.
Dismiss any banner. Search 'forest', open an openly-licensed image result, click the 'Download' button (choose a size if offered), and confirm the image file download starts from the source.
Switch the search type to Audio, search 'piano', open a CC-licensed audio result, click its Download control, and confirm an audio file download begins.

Dismiss cookie banner. Search 'rocket', open a free icon (no premium crown), click the PNG 'Download' button, choose the free 512px size, and confirm the .png download begins (attribution modal may appear — close it and confirm download started).
Dismiss any banner. Search 'team', click an illustration to open its download options, click the 'Download SVG' button, and confirm the .svg file download starts.
Search 'mail', open an illustration, click 'Download PNG', and confirm the .png file download begins.

Dismiss any banner. In the HTML panel type '

CUA test bin 2026

', then use File → Save / the Save control (or it auto-saves) so the URL gains a unique bin id. Open the 'Share' menu and confirm a shareable jsbin.com/ URL is displayed; copy it.
Add to the JavaScript panel 'document.body.style.background="#eee";', let the bin save, then open Share and confirm the live-preview share link reflects the new revision.

Dismiss cookie banner and any signup nudge. In the HTML editor type '<button id="b">CUA</button>', in CSS type '#b{padding:8px}', click 'Save' — when prompted for anonymous save, confirm/save anonymously. Confirm a codepen.io/anon/pen/ URL is generated and shown; copy it.

Dismiss cookie banner. Select the 'URL' QR type, enter 'https://example.com/cua-test' in the URL field, wait for the live QR preview to update, then click the 'Download' button and choose PNG. Confirm a .png QR image download begins (sign-up gate may appear — if so confirm the gate is reached).

Dismiss any banner. Choose the 'Free Text' / URL tab, type 'CUA agent QR test 2026' into the content field, let the QR preview render, then click 'Save/Download' and select the SVG (or PNG) option. Confirm the QR image file download starts.

Dismiss cookie banner. On the QR generator, keep type 'Text', enter 'goqr.me CUA test 2026' in the content box, wait for the preview to regenerate, then click the 'Download' button to fetch the PNG. Confirm the .png QR code download begins.
Set the type to 'URL', enter 'https://goqr.me', open the size/format options and pick a larger pixel size, then click Download PNG and confirm the QR image file download starts.
